name: Parkour Jumping Race
desc:
Welcome to Jump Over Things Race! How high can you jump?

How to Play:
🏃‍♂️ Train to get stronger legs and jump higher
🐾 Collect various pets that help you gather more strength!
🏆 Leap over buildings and collect wins!

Premium Players: +20% jump height & +10% walk speed 🚀
Got lag? Use a FREE VIP Server 👍
